title: Submission result
description: Response of POST /api/v1/submissions. Request body: { encounter_id, code, attempt_number?, elapsed_ms? }. attempt_number (default 1) is which try this is for the player and elapsed_ms is how long they spent; both are passed in by the caller and repeated back, and neither changes the score; they feed rating instead. Judges the encounter's hidden tests only and returns the authoritative verdict and score. Hidden test inputs and outputs are never returned. defeat is set only when the player's code was wrong (WRONG_ANSWER, RUNTIME_ERROR, TIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, COMPILATION_ERROR); it is null when accepted and when our own system failed. rating is the star rating from attempts and time, kept apart from score; it is null only for SYSTEM_ERROR.

tests.description: One entry per hidden test. Empty when verdict is SYSTEM_ERROR because the sandbox was unavailable.

first_attempt_clear.description: True only when attempt_number is 1 and the verdict is ACCEPTED. This is what the first-attempt rate counts.

stars.description: 0 unless ACCEPTED. Accepted: 1, plus 1 for a first try, plus 1 for clearing within par.

par_ms.description: Par time for the encounter difficulty: easy 300000, medium 600000, hard 1200000.

within_par.description: elapsed_ms <= par_ms. Null when elapsed_ms was not sent.

rating.description: Star rating from attempts and time. Never changes score.

concept.description: The encounter's main concept: the one the defeat screen names.

explanation.description: What a wrong submission probably got wrong, written for this encounter.
